object_description: Elongated rectangular volume with rounded vertical access elements
design_condition: The elongated volume is placed low on the base of an excavation within dense greenery, docking with the terrain on two sides but generating substantial excavations and consuming protected garden and access space.

positive.statement: The volume is elongated and elegantly proportioned, giving the proposal a consistent and clear attitude.

position.rationale: Elongated rectangular mass is clearly visible in plan and all elevations.

positive.statement: The clear and systematic division of the space-forming structure works consistently across all floors.

position.rationale: Regular point arrays across the elongated envelope support a systematic whole-building structural reading.

positive.statement: The facade design with interlocking horizontal and vertical elements is recognized as a valuable contribution to the sophisticated design of a temporary building.

position.rationale: Repeated horizontal and vertical surface elements are most legible along the elevations.

positive.statement: The supporting structure is consistent and simple, with well-distributed and almost symmetrical stabilizing walls.

position.rationale: Ground-level structural support is approximated along the visible perimeter and access-side ends.

positive.statement: The energy concept is plausibly and optimally solved, and the building should generate little maintenance effort.

position.rationale: Energy and maintenance performance are not spatially represented in the sampled exterior geometry.

positive.statement: The L-shaped foundation and retaining-wall arrangement is a valuable contribution to easy dismantling and component reuse.

position.rationale: Foundation-related geometry is approximated at the low perimeter near the apparent excavation interface.

negative.statement: The low placement produces considerable excavations whose overall appearance is unsatisfactory and does not fit the existing topography well.

position.rationale: Low-set footprint and ground-level edges indicate a substantial site interface, though excavation is not distinct.

negative.statement: The external vertical access is too technical, impairs access to the protected neighboring building, obscures the address, and consumes too much outdoor space.

position.rationale: Rounded vertical access elements are concentrated near the east and south-east end of the footprint.

negative.statement: The access arrangement creates a small-scale outdoor situation and offers little space for adequate open-space use.

position.rationale: Outdoor space is approximated immediately around the access end and low building perimeter.

negative.statement: The external access requires users to leave the climate envelope between floors, placing high demands on flexibility.

position.rationale: Inter-floor access is anchored to the visible external vertical elements at the east end.

negative.statement: Not all floors function autonomously, and the multifunctional rooms have proportions that are not ideal for their users.

position.rationale: Interior rooms are not visible; a plausible central interior region is constrained within the elongated envelope.

negative.statement: The susceptibility of the suspended ceilings to vibration would have to be demonstrated.

position.rationale: Ceilings are interior and absent from the exterior sample; placement is constrained to upper occupied levels.

negative.statement: The hot-water storage arrangement is unfavorable for hygienic reasons and should be replaced by an energy storage solution.

position.rationale: Storage is not distinguishable; a plausible internal service location is placed within the building envelope.

negative.statement: The building occupies a relatively large amount of plot space, while its facade development leads to average gray-energy values.

position.rationale: The elongated footprint visibly occupies a broad portion of the sampled horizontal extent.

negative.statement: Natural lighting in some of the main usable areas is insufficient.

position.rationale: Usable interiors are not visible; the marker approximates central occupied zones within the envelope.
